passive.en: Increases the wearer's Effect Hit Rate by {{value}}%. When the wearer deals DMG to an enemy that currently has 3 or more debuffs, increases the wearer's CRIT Rate by {{value}}%. After the wearer uses their Basic ATK, Skill, or Ultimate, there is a 100% base chance to implant Aether Code on a random hit target that does not yet have it. Targets with Aether Code receive {{value}}% increased DMG for 1 turn.

Increases the wearer's CRIT DMG by {{value}}%. When the wearer hits an enemy target, inflicts Mirage Fizzle on the enemy, lasting for 1 turn. Each time the wearer attacks, this effect can only trigger 1 time on each target. The wearer deals {{value}}% increased DMG to targets afflicted with Mirage Fizzle, and the DMG dealt by Ultimate additionally increases by {{value}}%.
